headline: Google and Samsung's Gemini smart glasses, made with Warby Parker, launch
summary: Google and Samsung launched their Gemini-powered smart glasses, made in partnership with Warby Parker and Gentle Monster. The Warby Parker and Gentle Monster frames cost $395 and $449 respectively.

claims.statement: Google and Samsung's Gemini-powered smart glasses, made with Warby Parker and Gentle Monster, have launched.

sources.quote: Google and Samsung’s Android XR Smart Glasses Are Finally Here
